name: CPG and Consumer Brands
summary: Covers consumer-products and consumer-brand investments: DTC and subscription brands, brands selling through marketplaces and retail or wholesale (food and beverage, supplements, personal care, household), and franchise and multi-unit consumer businesses. Returns come from volume times contribution margin; equity value from velocity, distribution and durable margin. The spine: volume that is not repeat purchase is rented. Prove repeat from cohorts (CBCV), prove sell-through from retailer POS against sell-in (the trade-loading test), compare channels on contribution margin after trade spend, fulfillment and CAC, hold gross margin flat unless supplier quotes prove otherwise, audit regulated-product quality data, and review franchise agreements and the FDD for no-poach liability.
one_check: No cohort file, no valuation on fundamentals: obtain customers acquired, active customers and orders by period (and, for wholesale, POS sell-through against sell-in by account), and rebuild repeat and contribution margin by channel yourself.

subtypes.name: DTC / subscription / marketplace-led brand
subtypes.description: Brands selling directly online or via marketplaces. Cohort data request (customers acquired, active, orders, revenue and gross margin per order by channel and cohort), acquisition-led growth test, LTV and CAC rebuilt from contribution, payment-processor reconciliation.

subtypes.name: Retail / wholesale brand
subtypes.description: Brands selling through distributors and retailers. Sell-in vs POS sell-through by account and week, distributor weeks of inventory, deductions and chargebacks, gross-to-net and trade spend, ACV distribution connected to velocity and repeat, delistings.

subtypes.name: Franchise / multi-unit consumer
subtypes.description: Franchisors and multi-unit operators. FDD Items 17, 19, 20 and 21, unit turnover, no-poach, non-solicit and wage-fixing clause review, non-compete enforceability, open AG and class-action exposure.

intake_questions.question: What share of revenue comes from DTC, marketplaces, wholesale/retail, and franchise royalties or company-operated units?
intake_questions.why: Sets subtypes and which channel tests (cohort, sell-through, FDD) apply.

intake_questions.question: Is the product regulated (food, beverage, supplements, personal care), and when was the last independent quality-system audit?
intake_questions.why: Triggers data-integrity audit and FDA correspondence requests (Akorn).

intake_questions.question: Is the brand subscription or repeat-purchase, and can it produce customers acquired, active customers and orders by month?
intake_questions.why: THE ONE CHECK: no cohort file, no valuation on fundamentals.

intake_questions.question: Does the deal include a revenue-based earnout?
In which countries or markets is the brand sold?
intake_questions.why: Needed for the household-debt-to-GDP macro check.

intake_questions.question: Does the business use co-packers or contract manufacturers, and does the plan assume COGS improvement with volume?
intake_questions.why: Triggers the supplier-quote requirement before crediting any gross-margin gain.

intake_questions.question: Is this a control acquisition of a brand at a premium?
intake_questions.why: Triggers walk-away discipline and synergy table (Quaker/Snapple, Kraft Heinz, Tyson/Hillshire).

requests.request: Provide channel-level P&Ls (DTC, marketplace, wholesale/retail, franchise) for 3 years and TTM showing contribution margin after trade spend, fulfillment, returns, payment fees and CAC.
requests.format: Monthly channel P&Ls reconciling to the consolidated P&L.
requests.why: Headline gross margin hiding thin contribution; channel mix masking.
requests.pass: Channel P&Ls reconcile to consolidated within 1%; contribution positive in every growth channel and within or explained against vendor bands (DTC 35% to 55%, marketplace single digits to about 34%, wholesale about 33%, WEAK).
requests.fail: Only blended metrics; negative contribution in the channel driving growth.
requests.verify: Rebuild from GL, marketplace and 3PL invoices.

requests.request: Provide the DTC cohort file: by month, customers acquired, active customers, orders, revenue and gross margin per order, by acquisition channel and cohort, since launch.
requests.format: CSV from e-commerce platform or data warehouse with query text.
requests.why: No cohort file, no valuation on fundamentals.
requests.pass: Complete file delivered; totals reconcile to DTC revenue within 2%.
requests.fail: Company cannot or will not produce it.
requests.verify: Our analyst reruns the query or pulls from the platform directly.

requests.request: Provide retailer POS sell-through by account and week, and brand shipments (sell-in) by account, for the last eight quarters.
requests.format: Retailer portal exports (e.g. retail link) and ERP shipment data.
requests.pass: Sell-in tracks sell-through by account; gaps explained by documented pipeline fills for new doors.
requests.fail: Sell-in exceeding sell-through quarter after quarter.
requests.verify: Pull retailer portal data with read-only credentials; confirm with top retailers.

requests.request: Provide 3 years of financial statements plus TTM and the revenue recognition policy.
requests.format: Audited or reviewed statements and written policy.
requests.pass: Statements tie to GL and tax returns; revenue recognized net of trade promotions consistently.
requests.fail: Gross revenue with trade spend below the line, or policy changes.

requests.request: Provide category growth data and the brand's share and velocity against the category set.
requests.why: Brand growing slower than category or losing share.
requests.pass: Brand velocity at or above category median; share stable or rising.
requests.fail: Velocity below category with distribution gains masking it.

requests.request: Provide the walk-away price and the basis for any brand premium.
requests.why: Brand acquisitions destroying value (Quaker/Snapple, Kraft Heinz, Tyson/Hillshire).
requests.pass: Walk-away price set before bidding from conservative cash flows; premium supported by probability-weighted, timed synergies.
requests.fail: Premium justified by brand narrative or cost cuts.
requests.verify: Compare with velocity and share trends.

requests.request: Provide revenue by country or market for the macro overlay.
requests.pass: Household-debt-to-GDP check run; if a market is in the top third of history, downside with revenue growth 2 points lower for 3 years.
requests.verify: We pull BIS / Fed Z.1 data.

requests.request: Provide the model with a base case holding gross margin flat unless each COGS reduction is backed by a signed supplier or co-packer quote at the higher volume.
requests.why: Margin plans that assume scale efficiencies.
requests.pass: Base-case gross margin flat at current; every credited reduction tied to a signed quote.

requests.request: Provide the CBCV-based valuation: value of existing customers plus future cohorts, with acquisition, retention, frequency and spend forecast separately.
requests.pass: Valuation on fitted cohort curves supports price.
requests.fail: Price exceeds CBCV with no explanation.

requests.request: Provide any revenue-based earnout terms with metric definitions and worked examples, efforts standard, reporting and audit rights, cost allocation, acceleration and expert scope.
requests.pass: All 5.11 checklist items present.
requests.fail: Vague revenue definitions (e.g. gross vs net of trade).

requests.request: Provide the synergy table for brand acquisitions: cost and revenue synergies with probability and timing and dis-synergies.
requests.pass: Probability-weighted and timed; dis-synergies included.

requests.request: Provide the gross-to-net bridge: gross sales, trade spend, deductions, chargebacks, returns and slotting, by retailer and month.
requests.pass: Bridge ties to remittances; trade spend as % of revenue stable or explained.

requests.request: Provide retailer deductions and chargebacks by account by quarter, with returns in the following quarter.
requests.why: Trade loading reverses as deductions and returns.
requests.pass: No rise in deductions or returns after quarter-end spikes.
requests.fail: Rising deductions and returns in the following quarter.

requests.request: Provide normalized EBITDA with add-back support, and working capital and cash conversion history.
requests.pass: Add-backs independently validated; cash conversion consistent with EBITDA.

requests.request: Provide bank and payment-processor settlement statements for 24 to 36 months to reconcile cohort and channel revenue to cash.
requests.format: Bank-issued and processor statements (Shopify, Stripe, Amazon settlements).
requests.why: Revenue that does not reach cash.
requests.pass: Cohort revenue reconciles to P&L and to settlements within 2%.

requests.request: Provide the inventory ledger with aging, turns and spoilage or write-offs by SKU.
requests.format: Perpetual inventory report and write-off history.
requests.why: Obsolete or spoiled inventory overstating assets.
requests.pass: Turns stable; aged and short-dated inventory reserved.

requests.request: Provide marketing spend by channel by month and new customers by channel.
requests.pass: Fully loaded CAC by channel computed; payback by channel tracked.

requests.request: Provide the promotion calendar with baseline and incremental volume per promotion.
requests.pass: Lift measured net of baseline is profitable after trade spend.

requests.request: Provide signed co-packer and supplier contracts and quotes at current and planned volumes.
requests.pass: Quotes support every COGS reduction in the plan.

requests.request: Provide the acquisition-led test: share of revenue each period from customers acquired in that period.
requests.pass: Share stable or falling while repeat holds.
requests.fail: Rising share with flat or falling repeat.

requests.request: Provide cumulative gross profit per cohort by month since acquisition.
requests.pass: Curves flatten; each recent cohort at least as valuable as prior.

requests.request: Provide repeat rates by cohort age for comparison with the category leader at the same age.
requests.pass: Repeat at or near the category leader.

requests.request: Provide the inputs to rebuild LTV and CAC: contribution after COGS, fulfillment, returns, payment fees and discounts per order, on the fitted repeat curve.
requests.pass: Our rebuilt LTV:CAC above 3:1 (WEAK) by channel.

requests.request: Provide distributor inventory reports and weeks of inventory at each distributor and retailer, today and a year ago, by quarter.
requests.why: Weeks of inventory rising while POS flat.
requests.pass: Weeks of inventory flat or falling.
requests.fail: Rising quarter over quarter with flat POS.

requests.request: Provide weekly shipments by account for the four weeks either side of each quarter-end.
requests.pass: No quarter-end spikes beyond normal pattern.

requests.request: Provide ACV distribution reconciled to door count, retailer authorizations, velocity against category and repeat.
requests.pass: ACV ties to authorizations; velocity and repeat support retention of shelf space.

requests.request: Provide customer and retailer concentration and any delistings in the last two years with reasons.
requests.pass: Concentration priced; delistings explained.

requests.request: Provide contacts for top retailers and distributors for direct confirmation of sell-through, inventory and deductions.
requests.pass: Confirmations match company data.

requests.request: Provide top-10 customer (retailer or distributor) purchase, inventory and AP trend data for the customer-side revenue test.
requests.pass: Brand shipments move with customers' purchases; no jumps in customer inventory.

requests.request: Provide FDA 483s, warning letters, recalls and regulator correspondence for 5 years.
requests.pass: No open findings.

requests.request: Provide quality-system audit trails and raw lab and testing data for released lots.
requests.pass: Raw data matches certificates and reported results.

requests.request: Provide product labeling and claims substantiation.
requests.pass: Every claim substantiated.

requests.request: Provide the current FDD and the last five years of FDDs.
requests.pass: Complete set provided.

requests.request: Provide FDD Item 19 financial performance representations with the population used.
requests.pass: System-wide or subset with criteria stated.

requests.request: Provide FDD Item 20 outlet openings, closings and transfers for five years.
requests.pass: Closings and transfers stable or falling.

requests.request: Provide FDD Item 21 audited franchisor financial statements.
requests.pass: Clean audit.

requests.request: Provide every franchise agreement, FDD Item 17, employment agreement and vendor contract containing no-poach, non-solicit or wage-fixing provisions, with removal dates.
requests.pass: No live clauses; removal documented.
requests.verify: Counsel review of a sample of agreements.

requests.request: Provide any open state AG inquiries or class actions related to no-poach or wage-fixing.
requests.pass: None open, or indemnified.

requests.request: Provide non-compete agreements for key employees with enforceability by state.
requests.pass: Enforceability analyzed.

requests.request: Provide access for an independent QoE with proof of cash.
requests.why: Financial-statement breaches drive 38% to 40% of R&W paid loss.
requests.pass: QoE with no unreconciled items.

requests.request: Provide site and system access for an independent data-integrity audit.
requests.pass: Clean audit.

requests.request: Authorize retailers and distributors to confirm data directly to us.
requests.pass: Confirmations received.

requests.request: Deliver specific indemnities for any regulatory, quality or no-poach finding and a price adjustment for trade-loading reversal.
requests.pass: Every finding covered.

requests.request: Deliver the executed earnout agreement with net-revenue definitions and audit rights.
requests.pass: Checklist complete.

requests.request: Deliver the cohort file monthly.
requests.pass: New cohorts at least as valuable as prior.

requests.request: Deliver POS, sell-in and distributor inventory by account quarterly.
requests.pass: Weeks of inventory flat or falling.

requests.request: Deliver channel P&Ls and gross-to-net bridge quarterly.
requests.pass: Contribution stable by channel.

requests.request: Deliver annual FDD and unit openings, closings and transfers.
requests.pass: Stable or improving.

kill_tests.test: Company cannot or will not produce customers acquired, active customers and orders by period (DTC) or POS sell-through by account (wholesale).
Sell-in materially exceeds POS sell-through with rising distributor weeks of inventory and the company cannot explain or reverse it (trade loading).
Regulated product with falsified or unreconcilable quality data found by an independent data-integrity audit.
Contribution margin by channel after trade spend, fulfillment and CAC cannot be produced or is negative in the channel driving growth.
Live no-poach or wage-fixing clauses with open AG or class-action exposure that is not indemnified or priced.

red_flags.flag: Only blended metrics; no channel-level contribution.
red_flags.check: Channel-level P&Ls with contribution after trade spend, fulfillment and CAC.

red_flags.flag: Distribution wins with no velocity data.
red_flags.check: Velocity by retailer against category set; repeat by retailer.

red_flags.flag: Trade spend and deductions not disclosed.
red_flags.check: Gross-to-net bridge and deductions and chargebacks by retailer.

red_flags.flag: Company cannot or will not give customers acquired and active customers by period.
red_flags.check: Kill test: no cohort file, no fundamental valuation.

red_flags.flag: LTV and CAC payback defined by the company on first-purchase contribution (Allbirds S-1 pattern).
red_flags.check: Rebuild LTV from fitted repeat curve and contribution against fully loaded CAC by channel.

red_flags.flag: Distributor or retailer weeks of inventory rising quarter over quarter while POS is flat.
red_flags.check: Sell-in vs POS by account; distributor inventory reports; direct confirmation.

red_flags.flag: Gross-margin expansion in the plan with no supplier quotes.
red_flags.check: Signed supplier or co-packer quotes at the higher volume, or flat margin base case.

red_flags.flag: No-poach or wage-fixing language in franchise or vendor agreements.
Regulated product with no recent independent quality-system audit.
Quarter-end shipment spikes followed by rising deductions and returns in the next quarter.
red_flags.check: Weekly shipments by account around quarter-ends; deductions and returns trend.

red_flags.flag: ACV distribution growth without matching velocity and repeat.
red_flags.check: Velocity per store or per $MM ACV and repeat by retailer.

red_flags.flag: Rising share of revenue from newly acquired customers with flat or falling repeat.
FDD Item 19 figures drawn from a selected subset rather than system-wide.
red_flags.check: Compare Item 19 population to Item 20 outlet counts.

red_flags.flag: Household debt to GDP in the brand's markets rose into the top third of history over three years.
red_flags.check: Run a downside with revenue growth 2 points lower for 3 years.

red_flags.flag: Premium for a brand justified by cost-cutting plans rather than velocity and share.
red_flags.check: Brand-value test against velocity and share trends; walk-away price.

red_flags.flag: Recent SKU delistings by a major retailer.
red_flags.check: Ask which retailers delisted which SKUs in two years and why; call the buyer.

metrics.acceptable: Units sold divided by number of stores (or per $MM ACV); benchmark against the category set; no institutional threshold.
Weighted percentage of retail volume where the SKU sells; must connect to velocity and repeat.
Above 3:1, recomputed from cohorts; track CAC payback by channel.
Often 30% to 40% early, higher at scale; higher at scale is an assumption to prove with supplier quotes (flat-margin base case).
None on average across 6,103 high-growth firms: hold gross margin flat in base case.
metrics.source: Thomas, Ertan and Lewellen, Yale Insights

metrics.acceptable: Track as % of revenue and trend; no institutional benchmark in this edition.

metrics.metric: Household debt to GDP macro trigger
metrics.acceptable: One-standard-deviation 3-year rise (6.2 points) predicts 2.1 points lower GDP growth over next 3 years; if in top third of history, downside with revenue growth 2 points lower for 3 years.

metrics.metric: R&W paid loss from financial-statement breaches

metrics.acceptable: Customer-inventory/AP signal carries about half the predictive power of the 11-variable Dechow model (about 30,000 supplier-years).
metrics.source: Zhang, Li and Li, Yale Insights

metrics.acceptable: About 70% of acquired customers churned within six months: the bad-cohort pattern.
About 58% of major franchisors' 2016 agreements contained no-poach clauses.

metrics.metric: Allbirds S-1 unit economics (pattern, not benchmark)
metrics.acceptable: CAC payback framed on first-purchase contribution on a $124 AOV; top-25% cohort lifetime spend $446: company projections, not audited.
Outside life sciences about one in five private deals; median about 31% of closing payments; median 24 months; revenue most common metric.

third_party_reports.report: Quality of earnings with proof of cash, gross-to-net and trade-spend testing
third_party_reports.required_when: Where EBITDA supports one; always for control deals

third_party_reports.report: Independent data-integrity audit of quality systems (raw lab data vs reported, FDA 483s, warning letters, audit trails)
Retailer and distributor confirmations of sell-through, inventory and deductions
third_party_reports.provider: Our deal team or commercial diligence firm

third_party_reports.report: Category and syndicated data (Circana/NielsenIQ) for velocity against the category set
Franchise and antitrust counsel review of agreements, FDD and no-poach exposure

third_party_reports.provider: Our analysts or a cohort-valuation specialist

hard_questions.question: Show contribution margin by channel after trade spend, fulfillment and CAC.
hard_questions.good_answer: Channel-level P&Ls reconciling to the consolidated P&L, with contribution per channel inside the vendor bands (DTC 35% to 55%, wholesale about 33%) or explained.

hard_questions.question: Show velocity by retailer against the category set, and repeat by retailer.
hard_questions.good_answer: Syndicated or retailer POS data by retailer with velocity at or above category median and stable repeat.

hard_questions.question: How many customers did you acquire each month, how many are active, and how many orders did they place?
hard_questions.good_answer: A monthly file produced immediately, reconciling to revenue and processor settlements.

hard_questions.question: What is POS sell-through against sell-in by account for the last eight quarters?
hard_questions.good_answer: Account-level table where sell-in tracks sell-through and gaps are explained by documented pipeline fills.

hard_questions.question: What are weeks of inventory at each distributor today, and a year ago?
hard_questions.good_answer: Distributor reports showing flat or falling weeks of inventory.

hard_questions.question: Which COGS reductions in the plan are backed by signed supplier or co-packer quotes?
hard_questions.good_answer: Each reduction tied to a signed quote at the planned volume; others removed from the base case.

hard_questions.question: What share of revenue was promoted, and what was lift net of baseline?
hard_questions.good_answer: Promo calendar with baseline and incremental volume showing profitable lift net of trade spend.

hard_questions.question: Show trade spend, deductions and chargebacks by retailer.
hard_questions.good_answer: A gross-to-net bridge by retailer tied to remittance data.

hard_questions.question: Has any retailer delisted a SKU in the last two years, and why?
hard_questions.good_answer: A complete list with reasons and corrective action, confirmed by buyers.

hard_questions.question: Show every agreement with a no-poach or non-solicit clause and when it was removed.
hard_questions.good_answer: A clause inventory with removal dates and no open exposure.

hard_questions.question: What does FDD Item 20 show about closures and transfers over five years?
hard_questions.good_answer: Stable or improving unit openings vs closings and transfers.

hard_questions.question: Are Item 19 figures system-wide or a selected subset?
hard_questions.good_answer: System-wide figures, or a subset with its selection criteria and population stated.

hard_questions.question: At the higher volume in the plan, what are co-packer and supplier quotes?
hard_questions.good_answer: Signed quotes; otherwise base case gross margin flat.

failure_cases.what_happened: About 70% of acquired customers churned within six months; declining cumulative net revenue per recent cohort; IPO range cut from $15-$17 to $10; shares later fell about 70% more.
CBCV under $10 per share against a stock near $64; growth made entirely of acquisition; repeat below Amazon's two decades earlier; stock fell about 10% the day the paper posted.
failure_cases.check: Share of revenue from new customers; repeat curve against the category leader.
Walk-away price; distribution and repeat tested before paying for brand.
Brand-value impairment test against velocity and share trends, not cost-cutting plans.

failure_cases.what_happened: 70% premium; about $2B destroyed against fair value near $47/share.
failure_cases.check: Premium justified only by probability-weighted, timed synergies.

failure_cases.what_happened: About 58% of major franchisors' 2016 agreements contained no-poach clauses (McDonald's, Burger King, Jiffy Lube, H&R Block); Washington AG and others forced abandonment; class actions followed.
failure_cases.check: Clause review; open AG and class-action exposure.

failure_cases.what_happened: Falsified quality data let Fresenius walk away under the MAE.
failure_cases.check: Independent data-integrity audit of quality systems for food and supplement makers.

failure_cases.what_happened: S-1 framed CAC payback against first-purchase contribution on a $124 AOV and top-25% cohort lifetime spend at $446: company projections, not audited.
failure_cases.check: Never use company-defined LTV; rebuild from cohorts and fully loaded CAC.
